note: In most graveyards, the graves just look very scattered and random. The most important thing with a graveyard is organization and balance.  The graves/headstones should be in symmetrical, even rows. Stone walls don't make sense for the graveyard perimeter itself. Stone walls should only be used for smaller mausoleum-type buildings within the graveyard and the back wall (opposite of the gate). EX-GRAVEYARD-05 does this PERFECTLY because only the back wall and the mausoleums are made from stone walls. The rest of the perimeter is all fence, giving it an even, symmetrical, and balanced feel. Try combining headstones with patches of dirt to make fresh-looking graves once in a while. Use more item variety, like coffins, more dead / spooky trees, buckets of tools, barrels, torches, bones, skulls,  etc. A graveyard should never have exclusively graves and no other objects.
